notes.title: 2024. 9/2 【0.9.4 版本更新】新增簡體版
notes.content:
2024. 9/2   【0.9.4 版本更新】
1.「記憶大挑戰」的提示金幣上調至 100
2. 新增簡體版本。

開發者的話：我最初只是要服務台灣的使用者，但沒想到有一名簡體玩家購買了，我看著後台記錄，他只能使用英打卻不能使用中打，似乎對他很不公平。即使是賠本生意，我也應該服務他，因此，我花了半個月開發了切換繁體／簡體版本功能

notes.title: August 12, 2024 [Version 0.9.3 Update]
notes.content:
1.Forced update of the coin ranking in the leaderboard.
2.Added twenty new questions to the "Chinese Typing Test" and four new questions to the "English Typing Test" to increase randomness.
(Thanks to zelda for providing suggestions for the above updates)

notes.title: 2024.8/6 [Version 0.9.0 Update]
notes.content:
2024.8/6 [Version 0.9.0 Update]

Added "Leaderboard" feature.
Adjusted "Chinese Test" mode, added an input field for easier character selection.

notes.title: Version 0.8.10 Update
notes.content:
2024. 8/2   [Version 0.8.10 Update]
1. Added "Chinese Test" mode
2. Fixed interface display error for 1280*720 resolution.

notes.title: [Version 0.8.9 Update]
notes.content:
[Version 0.8.9 Update]

Added "Zhuyin Hint" feature, which can be manually toggled on/off. Mouse over the blocks to view Zhuyin.
Adjusted "Chinese Typing" speed, further reduced by 30%.
Removed characters with more than 19 strokes from "Chinese Typing" to lower the difficulty level of Chinese characters.
(The above updates are based on suggestions from player "Lost Cloud")

notes.title: 7/29 [0.8.8 Minor Update]
notes.content:
7/29 [0.8.8 Minor Update]
1. Updated English word audio files, now using high-quality children's word pronunciations
2. Adjusted word speech rate, slowed down by 20%
(The above updates are thanks to the suggestion from player "CTY=99")

notes.title: 2024 7/28 Version 0.8.6
notes.content:
Added "English Typing Test" feature, where players can test their speed using long English passages and view their top three records.
Added 5 new background music tracks, which will automatically play in random order on loop. (Players are advised to adjust the volume of sound effects and music as needed)
Adjusted the difficulty of "Chinese Speed Typing," reducing speed by 20% and decreasing block generation speed by 10%.
Fixed an issue where idioms in "Idiom Speed Typing" were not randomized.
A message from the developer: "Thank you for your feedback. Regarding the issue of English words being too quiet, I am working on it and it will take a little more time to resolve.
